No spots, no fungal growth. This pattern strongly suggests a viral disease, most likely Cucumber Mosaic Virus.

Now I'll use my 1 reference image to confirm.

The reference image confirms the match. Both show the same characteristic CMV symptoms: severely distorted and curled leaves, shoestring/filiform leaf appearance at growing tips, and mottled light-dark green mosaic coloring — with no spots, lesions, or fungal growth.
